Abandoned

Abandoned by the JTF, Keener turns his back on the Division and goes Rogue Features AARON KEENER. Contains 1 dialogue exchanges. [1]

But what kind of mission is that? The government doesn't care about us. We're expendable, sure, but they have carelessly thrown us aside for no reason. And why should we sacrifice ourselves for a state that doesn't deserve it? We should all take a moment to reflect on that, and ask if the mission still stands. Me, I'm not so sure anymore [1]
